existing_outcome_summaries.qualitative_outcome: Single injections of either HGF or EGF mRNA-LNP decreased steatosis; combined HGF/EGF mRNA-LNP produced more efficient steatosis reversal. A sharp decrease was observed 2 days after the first combined injection, while steatosis was maintained in Poly(C) RNA-LNP-treated mice.
